source_authority: Parliament of India — the Acts that make each institute an Institution of National Importance

acts.NID: National Institute of Design Act, 2014, as amended in 2019 to add NID Andhra Pradesh, NID Madhya Pradesh, NID Assam and NID Haryana (5 NIDs in all)
acts.NIFTEM: National Institutes of Food Technology, Entrepreneurship and Management Act, 2021 (NIFTEM Kundli and NIFTEM Thanjavur)
acts.ITRA: Institute of Teaching and Research in Ayurveda Act, 2020 (No. 16 of 2020), https://ayush.gov.in/assets/pdf/ITRA_Act_2020.pdf — an Institution of National Importance at Jamnagar
acts.AIIA: All India Institute of Ayurveda, New Delhi — autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Ayush (https://aiia.gov.in); NOT an Institution of National Importance, so it is G3
acts.NFSU: National Forensic Sciences University Act, 2020 (Gujarat Forensic Sciences University and the LNJN National Institute of Criminology and Forensic Science became NFSU)
acts.RRU: Rashtriya Raksha University Act, 2020 (formerly Raksha Shakti University)
